LEFT: ONE real adult Uzbek man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a calm gentle gaze, soft rose-gold hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal anklets. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body.
